sponsoredBills.summary: The bill creates a federal crime for knowingly staging, fabricating, or simulating motor vehicle accidents to submit false insurance claims. Penalties include fines and up to 10 years imprisonment; 20 years if serious injury results; or life imprisonment if death occurs. Fines collected are deposited into the Highway Trust Fund.
sponsoredBills.title: Stop Auto Fraud Act of 2026

sponsoredBills.summary: Prohibits states and the federal government from limiting access to assisted reproductive technology or related medical care. Establishes statutory rights for individuals to access such services, for health care providers to offer them, and for insurance providers to cover them. Creates enforcement mechanisms including civil actions by the Attorney General and private right of action with attorney's fees.
sponsoredBills.title: Access to Family Building Act

sponsoredBills.summary: This bill directs the Department of Homeland Security to designate Haiti for temporary protected status (TPS) for 18 months beginning August 3, 2025. (Eligible nationals of a TPS-designated country may obtain employment authorization, may not be detained on the basis of their immigration status, and are not subject to removal while they retain TPS.)
sponsoredBills.title: To require the Secretary of Homeland Security to designate Haiti for temporary protected status.
